name: Saucy "Chicken Parmesan" Patty Melt with Mozzarella & Italian Greens

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven. Line a large baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make clean-up easier (optional).
Peel and mince garlic. Place in a small bowl along with tomato sauce and spices, then stir to combine. Transfer a ⅓-cup of the tomato sauce to a large bowl. (Set remaining sauce aside for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
1 ½ (213 ml) cans tomato sauce
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add chicken, bread crumbs, salt, and crushed red pepper to the large bowl with the tomato sauce, then mix with your hands until well combined. Form the chicken mixture into 6 equal-sized patties and arrange on the baking sheet. (The patties will be loose but will firm up when cooked.)
instructions.secondary_message:
0.68 kg ground chicken
1 cup panko bread crumbs
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drizzle patties with oil, then place baking sheet in the oven. Broil, flipping patties halfway, until chicken is cooked through and golden, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, roughly chop capers. Place in a clean large bowl along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp capers
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 ½ tsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tsp honey
¾ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drain and thinly slice artichoke hearts and sun-dried tomatoes. Add both to the bowl with the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (170 ml) jars artichoke hearts, marinated
9 sun-dried tomatoes, oil-packed

instructions.primary_message: When the patties are done, top with remaining sauce and cheese. Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to broil until sauce is warm and cheese is melted, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Arrange bread on another large baking sheet. Place baking sheet in the oven and broil until toasted, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven.
While the bread is toasting, wash and dry alfalfa sprouts. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Place a slice of toast on each plate and top with saucy patties. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
